summary: Iteration 19 - Distance filter (Рядом / Весь мир). Backend + Frontend fully verified. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass including radius filter correctness (10km near user included, 500km far user excluded when limited/50, both returned when unlimited) and Field(ge=0,le=2000) validation (422 on -5 and 2500, 200 on 0 and 2000). Frontend: default 'unlimited' hides slider row; selecting 'Рядом' reveals slider row with amber geolocation hint (no lat/lng), distance-label live-updates as slider moves (ArrowRight keyboard step=10 verified 50→200), mouseup triggers PUT /api/profile with {distance_km:200}, server persists distance_mode='limited' + distance_km=200. Switching back to '🌍 Весь мир' hides slider row and persists distance_mode='unlimited'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1612 lines — router split still recommended (unchanged from iter18).

_filter_feed: 'if user.get('lat')' truthy check would exclude viewers at exactly lat==0 (equator). Prefer explicit `is not None` (already done in the radius branch — inconsistent with the sort scoring branch above it).

SettingsPage saves on mouseup/touchend but NOT on keyboard interaction. A user changing the slider with ArrowLeft/Right (or Home/End) will not trigger the PUT — consider also saving onKeyUp or onChange debounced. Minor UX issue.
distance_km default fallback (?? 50) is duplicated in 3 places in JSX — extract to a constant.
